field.label: Enabled
field.help: Include this filter in filters.inc. Disabled filters are not loaded by BIRD.

field.label: Name
field.help: BIRD filter name (must be unique). Must match the include file name without .inc, e.g. NAME → /usr/local/etc/bird/NAME.inc. Use this name in a peer Import field.

field.label: Community
field.help: Select one enabled BGP community define. Leave as none for a filter without community match.

field.label: Address family
field.help: IPv4 or IPv6. The filter always rejects the default route first (0.0.0.0/0 for IPv4, ::/0 for IPv6) before accepting other prefixes, and sets Interface to ACTIVE_TUN4_IF or ACTIVE_TUN6_IF.

field.label: Interface
field.help: BIRD ifname identifier, shown for reference. It follows Address family: ACTIVE_TUN4_IF for IPv4, ACTIVE_TUN6_IF for IPv6.
